//schedule: Cadence is controlled by the workflow cron in .github/workflows/renovate.yml (self-hosted). Intentionally NOT set here, so every scheduled run is free to act instead of being gated to a window that could drift out of sync with the cron.
//: versions.env is the single source of truth init.sh cats into every stack's .env. Its bespoke `key = 'value'` format is invisible to native Docker managers, so we parse it with a custom regex manager — one block per product because the env-var name doesn't encode the Docker Hub namespace.

packageRules.description: Loudly flag major bumps — they may need config migration; a compose that starts is not proof the data model migrated.
